    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

                    and grid[r][c-1] == 2 and grid[r][c+1] == 2):
                centers.append((r, c))

    # Connect aligned motifs through their centers with 1s, leaving the 2s intact.
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(centers):
        for r2, c2 in centers[i+1:]:
            if r1 == r2:
                for c in range(min(c1, c2) + 2, max(c1, c2) - 1):
                    if out[r1][c] == 0:
